title: Fix "TryLock interrupted keeps renewing lock indefinitely"

timeline.message:
Fix "TryLock interrupted keeps renewing lock indefinitely"

Signed-off-by: César Luis Alvargonzález <cesar.alvargonzalez@revolut.com>
timeline.author: César Luis Alvargonzález

timeline.body: Ensures the future is cancelled and interrupted in case the caller thread gets interrupted.
If the thread has been interrupted (e.g by CommandAsyncService:115) it will cancel the expiration renewal
